definitions.gloss: dial; face (of a clock or watch)
definitions.explanation: The face of a clock or watch, marked with the numbers or hour marks that the hands point to. Also the face of a meter or a keyboard of letters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{文字盤|もじばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧。
examples.english: A watch with a white face.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文字盤|もじばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧やすい。
examples.english: This clock's face is easy to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕時計|うでどけい}→腕時計：04538_udedokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{文字盤|もじばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ローマ⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather's wristwatch has Roman numerals on its face.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧ (letters, numerals) + ⟦{盤|ばん}→盤：18576_ban⟧ (board, dial).
